heading: Time limitation on completion of affairs of Commission
lead: The Commission shall complete its affairs in connection with the settlement of claims pursuant to this subchapter not later than July 6, 1972.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1969—Pub. L. 91–157 set July 6, 1972, as the final date for the settlement of claims pursuant to this subchapter. 1966—Pub. L. 89–780 inserted “with respect to each respective claims program authorized” after “carrying out its functions”.
